# PVPspinArena

> PVPspinArena (https://pvpspinarena.com) has seven games: Jackpot, Coinflip, Roulette, P2P Slott, six-max No-Limit Texas Hold'em, 1v1 8-ball pool and PvPStrike browser FPS. Cash games share one US-dollar balance funded with Bitcoin, or USDC or ETH on Base. Random draws commit a seed; pool follows the shots and rules; FPS follows server-validated gameplay. Free FPS Practice is against a bot, with no stake or payout. Adults 18+ only. Play only with money you can afford to lose.

Jackpot, Coinflip, P2P Slott, poker, 8-ball and PvPStrike cash matches use player-funded pots. Roulette is a shared house-banked wheel, not a pot. Browser animation does not settle money. A committed seed lets you recompute a published draw. An 8-ball replay lets you recompute the winner from the shots; the rack seed does not pick the winner. PvPStrike is not a seed-based provably fair draw and has no public FPS replay verifier. None of these mechanisms insures a balance, protects a wallet, removes the fee or guarantees a profit. PVPspinArena is not affiliated with Valve, Counter-Strike or Steam. No gambling licence number, audit firm or company registration is published on the site.

## Games

- [Jackpot](https://pvpspinarena.com/): shared pot; every cent is one ticket, so win chance equals your share of the pot. Fee: 5% of the pot at settlement. The winner receives 95%.
- [Coinflip](https://pvpspinarena.com/coinflip): one versus one; one player picks heads or tails, the other takes the opposite side; one bit of HMAC-SHA256 gives each side a 50% chance. Fee: 5% of the combined pot. The winner receives 95%.
- [Roulette](https://pvpspinarena.com/roulette): timed rounds on a 33-slot wheel; 16 Purple and 16 Silver pay 2x, 1 Green pays 14x. Fee: 5% of each winning payout. After that fee, Purple or Silver returns about 92.12% (about a 7.88% house edge) and Green returns about 40.30% (about a 59.70% house edge).
- [P2P Slott](https://pvpspinarena.com/slott): two players, equal stakes, six spins each, higher score wins. Fee: 10% of the players' pot on a win. A draw refunds both stakes. A bomb ends the match and the house keeps both stakes.
- [Poker](https://pvpspinarena.com/poker): six-max No-Limit Hold'em, blinds from $0.02/$0.05 to $5/$10. Fee: 5% of a pot only when a flop is dealt. Preflop hands pay no fee.
- [8-ball pool](https://pvpspinarena.com/8-ball-pool): 1v1, stakes $1, $2, $5, $10, $25 and $50. Shots, timeouts and forfeits determine the winner; the rack seed does not pick the winner. Fee: 5% of the pot on a win. An unjoined table refunds after 24 hours; there is no manual waiting-table cancellation. If both players leave before the break, stakes are refunded. A live-table exit forfeits the seat.
- [PvPStrike FPS](https://pvpspinarena.com/fps-duel): independent desktop browser shooter on Dustfront. Human-only cash matches are best of thirteen, with a 5% pot fee on a win. Free bot Practice is first to seven. Sides switch after round six during a five-second halftime break. Police carry an M4A1-S; Terrorists carry an AK-47. Scores stay with each player. [FPS rules and public results](https://pvpspinarena.com/fps-1v1) distinguish recorded cash results from random-draw verification.

## How the site works

Free [8-ball Practice](https://pvpspinarena.com/pool/practice) runs locally against a dedicated bot. It shares the real-match layout, live chat, physics, shot rules and presence-aware 30-second clock, with no deposit, stake, fee or payout. The unfinished rack is saved in the browser tab's session storage. Practice does not enter cash game history or move wallet funds.

- [How it works](https://pvpspinarena.com/how-it-works): account, wallet, deposits, each game, and verification
- [Fairness](https://pvpspinarena.com/fairness): draw protocols, pool replay and the limits of FPS server validation
- [About](https://pvpspinarena.com/about): what the platform is and is not
- [Editorial policy](https://pvpspinarena.com/editorial): no named author, what dates and sources mean, how to send a correction
- [Responsible gambling](https://pvpspinarena.com/responsible-gambling): limits and self-exclusion
- [Terms](https://pvpspinarena.com/terms): game-specific fees, waiting and disconnect rules, and eligibility
- [Privacy](https://pvpspinarena.com/privacy): account, wallet, gameplay and connection data, and public-result visibility
